text: Zybuu. Infrastructure for AI that has to stay under your control.
Every enterprise is about to run AI agents: software that reads, decides, acts, and reports across the code, the tickets, the records, and the systems a business runs on.
The market sells that one way. A vendor's cloud. A vendor's model. And your data leaving the building on every single turn.
For banks and insurers, for hospitals, for defence and government, and for anyone with a data-residency clause in a customer contract, that is not a product. It is a wall.
So most of them are building the layer themselves. A loop. A sandbox that is not quite one. A log that is not quite complete. An approval step that only works when someone happens to be watching.
Zybuu builds that layer, properly, once. Infrastructure for AI workloads under your own control: software as a service, private cloud, or fully air-gapped, with the same guarantees at every tier.
That is our vision. The part that decides what a model may do, does it safely, records it, and can prove afterwards exactly what happened. As a product, not a project.
Our first product is Abhed: an agent harness for work that cannot leave the building. It is live today, and it is only the beginning.
Behind it, on the same foundations: workload benchmarking, agent security and red-teaming, observability for agents, inference infrastructure, and private cloud deployment.
Zybuu. Run AI where your data already lives. Find us at zybuu dot com.
